name: Priya Nair
review: Fantastic services from start to finish. The sales team explained every option and never pushed us into a decision. We drove home in a Certified RAV4 the same afternoon.

name: Marcus Bell
review: The car is great but the finance office was slow and the paperwork took almost three hours.

name: Elena Rossi
review: Visited the showroom to compare two SUVs. The staff was polite and the test drive was well organised.

name: Jordan Ellis
review: Excellent experience. The price was transparent, the trade-in value was fair and the delivery was on time.

name: Sofia Almeida
review: Friendly and helpful team. They even arranged a loaner car while ours was in service.

name: Dwayne Porter
review: Terrible communication. Nobody returned my calls for a week and the delivery date kept moving.

name: Hannah Kim
review: Good selection of trucks and the salesperson knew the products well. Recommended.

name: Luis Ortega
review: Fantastic services and a very smooth buying process. The team handled the registration for us.

name: Nina Patel
review: The price was higher than the online quote and the extra fees were not explained upfront.

name: Owen Garcia
review: Wonderful staff, quick test drive and a clean showroom. I would buy here again.

name: Aisha Thompson
review: Average visit. The car was fine but the wait to speak with a salesperson was long.

name: Peter Novak
review: Professional, honest and really easy to work with. The service department is outstanding too.
